item.title: US President Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz US territory
item.description: US President Donald Trump said he will “soon” declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory.

item.title: Venezuela says 131 political prisoners freed amid post-Maduro talks
item.description: As detainees granted 'alternative' to imprisonment, US welcomes release as crucial step for Venezuela's reconciliation.

item.title: 7.7-magnitude earthquake strikes eastern Indonesia
item.description: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck eastern Indonesia, damaging buildings and sending residents to higher ground.

item.title: At least two killed as magnitude 7.7 quake hits Indonesia
item.description: Authorities urge coastal residents to move inland or to higher ground following the quake near Flores Island.

item.title: Mangione pleads guilty as polarising CEO killing reaches new phase
item.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty to federal charges over the fatal shooting of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson in 2024.

item.title: Buenaventura residents criticise state neglect after Colombia’s earthquake
item.description: Locals in impoverished areas say the insufficient government response after the earthquake speaks to a broader trend.

item.title: Lula holds slim lead over Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Brazil election
item.description: A new poll shows Lula leading Bolsonaro, but the gap has closed ahead of Brazil's high-stakes presidential election.

item.title: UN urges support for Afghan women’s aid five years into Taliban rule
item.description: More than half of women’s organisations operating in Afghanistan could cease operations within next year: UN Women.

item.title: Families angered by slow search for loved ones after Colombia quake
item.description: Families are demanding answers over loved ones buried under rubble in Cali, Colombia after Monday’s 7.4 magnitude quake.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump vows to make Hormuz US territory ‘pretty soon’
item.description: US President Trump says that 'pretty soon' he will declare the Strait of Hormuz a US territory once Iran is defeated.

item.title: Lebanon’s PM urges timetable for Israeli withdrawal as Hezbollah slams deal
item.description: Hezbollah criticises Beirut’s approach, accusing officials of exposing the Lebanese army to risks and Israeli pressure.

item.title: Houthi attack on port kills four eroding truce with Yemen’s government

item.description: Hostilities are rising between Iran-backed Houthis and Yemen's internationally recognised government.

item.title: Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz a US ‘territory’ amid Iran war
item.description: Control over the strait has been a sticking point in the ongoing ceasefire negotiations between the US and Iran.

item.title: Wildfires rage across Europe as heatwaves drive record temperatures
item.description: Wildfires fuelled by record heat are ravaging Europe, burning around 500,000 hectares and forcing thousands to flee.

item.description: Flights will be suspended until at least Saturday afternoon, leaving hundreds of travellers stranded.

item.title: Former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism found dead
item.description: Police are treating sociology professor Jason Arday's death as unexpected but not suspicious.

item.description: A potential environmental disaster is unfolding off Oman, where a grounded tanker is leaking sanctioned Russian oil.

item.title: Trump asks US Supreme Court to allow $400m ballroom project to proceed
item.description: Appeals court previously ruled that Trump administration must seek authorisation from Congress to continue with project.

item.title: Woman charged over vandalism of World War II Memorial in Washington, DC
item.description: The arrest comes weeks after Trump criticised Jeanine Pirro for dropping charges over damage to the Reflecting Pool.

item.title: Italian police recover stolen paintings worth over $10m
